canonical_data: SQLite for state and schedules, a Qdrant vector store for episodic, semantic and procedural memory, and versioned evolved configuration files
current_repo_note: Covers the open-source Phantom runtime in this repository. Its agent loop is the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, a separately licensed dependency that this licence does not cover; a second runtime shim can be selected by environment variable. The free managed Phantom and the wider Ghostwright products the README lists are vendor-operated services and are not reviewed here.
strengths: Self-modification is gated: proposed config changes pass five validation gates with cross-model judges, a minority veto, stored versions, and rollback, which is more control than most self-improving agents describe
Memory is a real subsystem with episodic, semantic, and procedural stores over Qdrant plus consolidation and ranking code, and runtime-created MCP tools persist across restarts
Secrets are collected through encrypted forms rather than plain config, and the same instance is an MCP server other clients and other instances can call
weaknesses: The README advertises an agent that builds infrastructure without asking permission, so autonomy is the headline default rather than an approval-gated mode
The agent loop is the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, so the open code sits on a separately licensed, provider-owned runtime, and the other backends reach it through Anthropic-compatible endpoints
The headline examples are the maintainers' own production instances with no independent verification, and the repository was created in March 2026
why_it_matters: A concrete, inspectable attempt at an always-on, self-improving agent with its own machine, whose evolution pipeline treats unattended self-modification as a safety problem to gate.
